- Do not select C solely because the item is from the east region. C was rejected for REQ-2400, 2401, 2403, 2404, 2405, 2408, and 2409.
- C was accepted for REQ-2402 (shipment), REQ-2406 (invoice), and REQ-2407 (shipment), even where the displayed options appeared truncated or showed only A/B. Therefore, displayed option text may be incomplete or unreliable.

- Shipment and invoice requests have mixed outcomes for C, so no dependable item-type rule is established. Verify the complete option set and request-specific routing rule before choosing C; otherwise use A or B according to the applicable priority policy.
